lines.en: And when the morning comes, don’t wake. Stay closed, oh tired eyes.
lines.zh: 而当清晨来临，别醒来。闭上吧，疲惫的眼睛。

lines.en: With distance still and bones to break, the shape of our demise-
lines.zh: 距离依旧，骨头仍要折断，我们灭亡的形状——

lines.en: Shall mold the neon hearts we share, remind us who we are.
lines.zh: 将塑造我们共有的霓虹之心，提醒我们是谁。

lines.en: Survivors in a dying world. Two strangers in two cars.
lines.zh: 垂死世界里的幸存者。两辆车里的两个陌生人。
又是霉味。
熟悉，却又不熟悉。

lines.en: Now masked by the smoke-tendril arms of cheap scented candles, this is nothing like the floor of an old, lived-in apartment.
lines.zh: 如今被廉价香薰蜡烛那烟雾般的触手手臂遮掩着，这里跟那间有人住过的老公寓的地板截然不同。

lines.en: This is a place where people come to forget under the pretense of making memories. And it is somewhere you never thought you’d see come the morning after.
lines.zh: 这是一个人们以「制造回忆」为名来遗忘的地方。也是你从没想过自己会在第二天清晨看到的地方。

lines.en: Tell me, Friend — what did you dream of last night?
lines.zh: 告诉我吧，朋友——你昨晚梦见了什么？

lines.en: Ignore me all you like. It does not change the fact that I grow within you like that dragon grows in her.
lines.zh: 你想无视我就尽管无视。改变不了我在你体内生长的事实，就像那条龙在她体内生长一样。
: Sensei？……

lines.en: How comfortable it must be — to have the arms you’ve always dreamt of plunged deep in the stomach of your nightmares — draped over you like the curtains you plucked from the side of the road just last month.
lines.zh: 那该有多舒服啊——让你一直梦想的臂弯深深插进你噩梦的腹中——像你上个月刚从路边捡回来的窗帘那样盖在你身上。

lines.en: They smell of mildew too, I’m sure. You haven’t learned how to get rid of it yet. And that’s just one of the many things you likely won’t {i}ever{/i} learn if you stay where you are now.
lines.zh: 它们大概也有霉味。你还没学会怎么去掉它。而这只是你若一直停在原地、很可能{i}永远{/i}学不会的众多事情之一。

lines.en: Would you like to go back, Yumi?
lines.zh: 你想回去吗，Yumi？
因为你{i}可以{/i}。

lines.en: All you need to do is make a wish.
lines.zh: 你只需要许个愿。

lines.en: She lightly removes the arm of the man who comforted her last night, placing it gently by his side as she seizes a very rare opportunity to get a look at his face while he can’t see hers.
lines.zh: 她轻轻挪开昨晚安慰了她的那个男人的手臂，把它轻柔地放到他身侧，抓住这个极其难得的机会——趁他看不见她的时候，看看他的脸。

lines.en: Her gaze lingers on his eyes — closed and moving rapidly behind his eyelids like the sockets are full of worker ants. Like his body is their underground lair.
lines.zh: 她的目光停在他的眼睛上——闭着，在眼皮后快速转动，像眼窝里塞满了工蚁。像他的身体就是它们地下的巢穴。

lines.en: She thinks about removing his glasses. She didn’t want him to risk breaking them if he rolled over now that he wasn’t anchored to her body.
lines.zh: 她想过把他的眼镜摘下来。既然他不再被她的身体固定住，万一翻身压坏了，她不想让他冒这个险。
但她没有。

lines.en: She just stares at him. Half thankful. Half cherished. Two halves that were entirely unfamiliar to her, yet combined to create something or somewhere that just felt right.
lines.zh: 她只是盯着他看。一半是感激。一半是珍惜。这两个「一半」对她来说完全陌生，可合在一起，却造出了某种、或某个让她觉得刚刚好的东西。

lines.en: But one good thing in a sea of bad things can not offset that ever-encroaching darkness. And while {i}these{/i} halves were good ones, there were two others that {i}always{/i} dragged her down.
lines.zh: 但在一片糟糕之中，一件好事抵消不了那不断逼近的黑暗。虽然{i}这两个{/i}「一半」是好的，却还有另外两个{i}一直{/i}在把她往下拖。

lines.en: They followed her everywhere. They determined everything about her life. Yet, she was afraid to leave them behind because she was unsure of what else she might find.
lines.zh: 它们如影随形。它们决定了她人生的一切。可她不敢把它们抛在身后，因为她不确定自己还能找到别的什么。
她决定继续盯着看。
: ……Yumi？
他决定醒过来。
: 几点了？……
: 我不知道……

lines.en: : You can go back to sleep, though. It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 不过你可以接着睡。没事的。

lines.en: : What are you going to do?...
lines.zh: : 那你打算做什么？……

lines.en: : I have to get ready for school.
lines.zh: : 我得准备去学校了。

lines.en: : I imagine it’s still pretty early since I can’t hear anybody fucking anymore.
lines.zh: : 我猜现在应该还很早，因为我已经听不到有人在操了。

lines.en: : School? Are you kidding? Take the day off. You’ve never had a better reason to skip than this.
lines.zh: : 学校？你开玩笑吧？请一天假。你从来没有比这更好的逃课理由了。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s exactly why I ain’t doin’ it this time.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这正是我这次不逃的原因。
: 解释一下？

lines.en: : The fuck do you think is gonna happen if I just do my own thing again all day?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我要是又整天自己瞎混，会发生什么？

lines.en: : Question ain’t for you to answer, numbnuts. It’s one of those rhetorical ones or whatever they’re called.
lines.zh: : 这问题不是给你答的，蠢货。这是那种……反问句，还是管它叫什么来着。

lines.en: : If I stay here, I’ll wind up beatin’ myself up until I feel even fuckin’ worse. And you saw me last night. This shit fucking sucks. Figure school will at least distract me.
lines.zh: : 要是我就这么待着，我会一直自责到感觉更他妈的糟。而且你昨晚也看到了。这事儿真的难受。我想学校至少能让我分分心。

lines.en: : I can be a distraction too. Going to school now is-
lines.zh: : 我也能当个让你分心的东西。现在去上学是——

lines.en: : You’ve done your part already, okay? I mooch off you any longer and Chika won’t even be able to convince herself she’s “winning” anymore.
lines.zh: : 你已经做了你那份了，好吗？我再继续蹭你，Chika 连自欺欺人说自己「赢了」都做不到了。

lines.en: : I’ll pay you back for the room as soon as I can. But-
lines.zh: : 我会尽快把房钱还你。不过——
: 不过……什么？
: 没什么。

lines.en: : Just...I’ll pay you back as soon as I can. Maybe Noriko can ask the boss to give me an advance on my next paycheck or-
lines.zh: : 就是……我会尽快还你。也许 Noriko 能跟老板说一声，让我预支下一次的工资什么的——

lines.en: : You don’t need to pay me back. Put it toward getting the power back on at Chika’s old place. I can help you pay the bill.
lines.zh: : 你不用还我。拿去给 Chika 以前那地方把电通上吧。电费我可以帮你付。

lines.en: : I already fuckin’ told you you’ve done enough.
lines.zh: : 我他妈的说了你已经做得够多了。

lines.en: : By spending one night with you and barely saying anything?
lines.zh: : 就陪了你一夜、几乎什么都没说？
: 你还……抱了我之类的……
: 那{i}有用{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Helped me...realize there’s still some shit out there scarier than cancer, yeah.
lines.zh: : 让我……意识到这世上还有比癌症更可怕的东西，有。
: 今天别去学校。

lines.en: : You ain’t gonna talk me outta this, Sensei...but I...appreciate you looking after me.
lines.zh: : 你是劝不动我的，Sensei……不过我……很感激你照顾我。

lines.en: : Just want to...try and get shit back to normal. Forget I read anything. Probably just...some kinda misunderstanding anyway.
lines.zh: : 我只是想……试着让一切回到正轨。就当我什么都没看到。反正大概……也就是某种误会吧。
: 或者……我们可以聊聊这件事。

lines.en: : We do that too much now.
lines.zh: : 我们现在聊得太多了。

lines.en: : Like...don’t you ever miss the days when I was just some fuckin’ delinquent you’d chase around on your quest to fuck every high school girl in Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 就像……你难道一点都不怀念以前吗？那时候我只是个你为了睡遍 Kumon-mi 每一个高中女生而到处追着跑的不良少女。

lines.en: : Sometimes. But then I think about things like this and how, if we hadn’t ever become more, that you’d be all alone during the hardest times of your life.
lines.zh: : 有时候会。可我一想到这种事就会想，要是我们从来没有变得更亲近，你人生中最难熬的时候就会是孤零零一个人。

lines.en: : You mean like what I’m tryin’ to do right now despite you practically beggin’ me to stay?
lines.zh: : 你是指就像我现在硬要做的事，尽管你几乎是在求我留下？

lines.en: : Exactly. Now sit back down or I’m going to come back to school for the sole purpose of making sure you have detention every day for the rest of your never-ending school life.
lines.zh: : 没错。现在坐回去，不然我就回学校去，唯一的目的就是确保你剩下的无限期校园生活里每天都被留堂。
: 等等……对啊……

lines.en: : If we’re fuckin’ stuck here and shit, that means Yuki ain’t gonna go anywhere...right?! Her thing’ll just...reset! Back to normal! Right?!
lines.zh: : 要是我们他妈的被困在这儿之类的，那不就意味着 Yuki 哪儿也去不了……对吧？！她那毛病就会……重置！回到正常！对吧？！
: 我不知道，Yumi。

lines.en: : The thing with Makoto’s dad is really the only example we have of death within the timeloops. And it’s not like we can just call him up to see if he’s alive again.
lines.zh: : Makoto 爸爸的事，真的是我们在时间循环里唯一一个死亡的例子。而且我们又不能打个电话去问他是不是又活过来了。

lines.en: : Like...maybe if we get {i}another{/i} call about him dying, we can assume things like that can happen. But without anything to go off of, we’ve just...
lines.zh: : 就像……也许如果我们{i}再{/i}接到一次他死讯的电话，就能假定这种事是可能发生的。可没有任何依据，我们就只能……
: 嗯。行吧。我懂了。
: 总之，学校。回头见。

lines.en: : Just like that? You’re not even wearing your uniform.
lines.zh: : 就这样？你连校服都没穿。
: 我的——
: 啊，操。忘了这茬。

lines.en: : Not exactly...used to spending the night in...seedy love hotels...
lines.zh: : 我可不太……习惯在那种……破烂情趣酒店过夜……

lines.en: : Guess you have no choice but to skip school entirely then.
lines.zh: : 那看来你别无选择，只能干脆逃一整天课了。

lines.en: : It’s barely past five in the morning. I’ve got time to make it to the dorms and get changed beforehand.
lines.zh: : 现在才刚过早上五点。我还有时间先回宿舍换衣服。

lines.en: : Can I walk you {i}there{/i} at least?
lines.zh: : 至少让我送你{i}过去{/i}吧？
: 不行。
: 为什么？

lines.en: : Because walking out of a love hotel with a girl like me ain’t gonna be good for your public image. Nor would be walking me to the dorm while everyone else is getting ready.
lines.zh: : 因为跟我这种女孩从情趣酒店里走出来，对你的公众形象可没好处。在大家都在准备上学的时候送我回宿舍也一样。

lines.en: : You think I wanna be bombarded by questions right now, man? If I’m alone, people will just do what they always do and avoid me. That’s exactly what I need from everyone but {i}you{/i} apparently.
lines.zh: : 你觉得我现在想被人围着问个不停吗，老兄？要是我一个人，大家就会照惯例躲着我。这正是我想从所有人那里得到的东西——除了{i}你{/i}，显然。

lines.en: : You’re not even going to tell Chika then? Because I feel like she’d be better at dealing with this sort of thing than literally anyone since she’s essentially gone through it already.
lines.zh: : 那你也完全不打算告诉 Chika？我总觉得她应付这种事大概比任何人都在行，因为她基本上已经经历过一遍了。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s why I said she’s a “whole thing” yesterday.
lines.zh: : 是啊，所以我昨天才说她是一「整件事」。

lines.en: : Oh. I thought you were just talking more about how my penis broke her.
lines.zh: : 哦。我还以为你只是在说我的鸡巴把她搞坏了。

lines.en: : Yeah, that definitely doesn’t help. But even if you broke her, she’s still my best friend. I don’t want to bring back bad memories.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那确实没帮上忙。不过就算是你把她搞坏的，她还是我最好的朋友。我不想让她想起那些难受的回忆。

lines.en: : I’m sure she’d be fine with it under the circumstances, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我相信在这种情况下她不会介意的，Yumi。
: 大概吧……但还是。

lines.en: : At the very least...talk to your mom. If you can find her, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少……去跟你妈谈谈。只要你找得到她的话。

lines.en: : She hasn’t exactly been {i}reliable{/i} lately, and...I guess now I’m starting to understand {i}why.{/i} But I had no idea something like {i}this{/i} was-
lines.zh: : 她最近确实不怎么{i}靠得住{/i}，而且……我想我现在才开始明白{i}为什么{/i}。可我完全不知道竟然是{i}这种{/i}——
: 我就不能当没看见吗？……

lines.en: : Can’t we just...try and see if the reset thing takes care of it?
lines.zh: : 我们就不能……先看看重置能不能把这事解决掉？
: 可要是没解决呢？

lines.en: : Then I guess it’s good I’ve already gotten used to how it feels when she ain’t around.
lines.zh: : 那我猜还好我已经习惯了她不在身边的感觉。
: Yumi……你不是那个意思。

lines.en: : Of course I don’t fuckin’ mean that...
lines.zh: : 我当然他妈的不是那个意思……

lines.en: : But it’s easier to say than admitting I was starting to fucking {i}forgive{/i} her.
lines.zh: : 但这么说，比承认我开始他妈的{i}原谅{/i}她要容易。

lines.en: : It’s easier to say than thanking her for making an effort for the first time in her fucking life! Easier than letting her try to be a part of mine!
lines.zh: : 这么说，比感谢她这辈子第一次肯努力要容易！比让她试着参与我的人生要容易！

lines.en: : I was fine without her! She could’ve just stayed gone! But now she’s shown back up, made me realize what I’ve been missing all these years, and she’s just going to leave me again?! What the fuck?!
lines.zh: : 没有她我过得挺好的！她一直消失不就行了！可现在她回来了，让我意识到这些年我错过了什么，然后她又要再一次丢下我？！这他妈的算什么？！

lines.en: : Sorry, I...didn’t mean to yell. I know it ain’t your fault.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我……不是故意吼的。我知道这不怪你。

lines.en: : You can hit me if you want too. I make a good punching bag in times like this.
lines.zh: : 你想打我也行。这种时候我是个很好的沙袋。

lines.en: : Yeah, I bet you’d fucking like that, wouldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 是啊，我猜你肯定他妈的喜欢这样吧？
: 也许换个更开心的场合，是的。

lines.en: : Thank you again. For...all of this.
lines.zh: : 再次谢谢你。为……这一切。

lines.en: : Thank you for not reporting me to the police after I assaulted you on a bridge. That single decision is what made it possible for us to grow this close.
lines.zh: : 该谢的是你——我在桥上袭击了你，你却没报警。正是那一个决定，才让我们有可能变得这么亲近。

lines.en: : Best thing I’ve ever not done, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概是我这辈子做过的最棒的一件「没做的事」吧。
: 在学校好好玩，Yumi。
: 嗯……我走了。

lines.en: Black oak door, carpet floor. Everything you’d want and more!
lines.zh: 黑色橡木门，地毯地板。你想要的一切，这里都有，甚至更多！

lines.en: But just because you’re pining for a place to go to hide from your-
lines.zh: 可就算你渴望一个能躲开你的——

lines.en: Regrets or past, ole’ childish lore. Not quite recalled, yet not ignored.
lines.zh: 遗憾或过去、那些老掉牙的幼稚传说的地方。没怎么想起来，却也没被忽略。

lines.en: All of this shan’t come to pass. Not the chiming of distant bells that signal to you when it’s time to bend, nor the slowly manifesting sound of an EKG that becomes evermore haunting the longer it drones on for.
lines.zh: 这一切都不会发生。不会响起远处那提醒你该低头屈服的钟声，也不会慢慢浮现出那台心电图机越来越折磨人的嗡鸣。

lines.en: Could this be a case where you’d {i}want{/i} to welcome that pain, though?
lines.zh: 不过，这会不会是你{i}愿意{/i}迎接那种痛苦的情况呢？

lines.en: Is one’s perpetual suffering worth the joy their presence brings you? And if that person has sinned, would such a fate be deserved?
lines.zh: 一个人永恒的苦难，配得上他存在所带来的喜悦吗？而如果那个人犯过罪，这样的命运是她应得的吗？

lines.en: How much pain is enough for you, Yumi? What is it that {i}you{/i} want?
lines.zh: 多少痛苦对你{i}来{/i}说才够，Yumi？你到底想要什么？
: {size=-15}咬我啊。{/size}
: 嗯？你说什么了吗？

lines.en: Yes... acknowledge me! Cultivate me! Let me grow in fields I’ve never seen before! Let me breathe in the stagnant, stale air of love hotels and dilapidated apartments! I can smell the pork broth from here!
lines.zh: 对……承认我吧！栽培我吧！让我在从未见过的田野里生长！让我呼吸情趣酒店和破败公寓里滞闷陈腐的空气！我从这儿都能闻到猪肉汤的味道！
: 不……只是叹了口气。
: 哦……那好吧。
: 那我就……待在这儿。

lines.en: : Call me if you need me.
lines.zh: : 需要的话就给我打电话。

lines.en: Go! Experience life! Distract yourself from {i}me!{/i} For {i}I{/i} will be the one to-
lines.zh: 去吧！去体验人生！把{i}我{/i}当成干扰去分心吧！因为{i}我{/i}才是那个将要——
: {size=-15}我说了咬我啊……{/size}
: Yumi？
: 你是不是忘了——
: 是的。
: {i}好了{/i}，我走了。
: 你刚刚亲了我。

lines.en: : So what? Ain’t like we haven’t done that before. This one had nothing on our first.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？我们又不是没亲过。这次跟第一次根本没法比。
: 你……刚刚亲了我。
: 这是你应得的。

lines.en: : But if you tell anyone, you will die.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是告诉任何人，你就死定了。
: 我走啦！
: 在学校好好玩……

lines.en: She thought about something for a second.
lines.zh: 她想了一会儿什么事。

lines.en: She thought about casting aside her typical lone-wolf personality in favor of one who enjoys herself a little more.
lines.zh: 她想过抛开自己一贯的独行侠性格，换成一个能多享受一点人生的自己。

lines.en: But she backtracked the moment she made it onto school grounds and saw the way her peers scattered like roaches once the lights go on.
lines.zh: 可就在她踏进校园、看到同学们像开灯后的蟑螂一样四散奔逃的那一刻，她退缩了。

lines.en: She turned her phone off shortly after that. It kept ringing, but she didn’t know what to say to the voice she expected to hear on the other end of it.
lines.zh: 没过多久，她把手机关了。手机一直在响，可她不知道该对另一端那个她预料得到的声音说些什么。

lines.en: Soon, her best friend found her. Turns out she had gotten a call as well. So she asked Yumi if everything was alright.
lines.zh: 很快，她最好的朋友找到了她。原来她也接到了一个电话。于是她问 Yumi 是不是一切都好。

lines.en: Yumi lied and said yes. It was at that point she began to question everything.
lines.zh: Yumi 撒谎说一切都好。就在那一刻，她开始质疑一切。

lines.en: She needed a distraction to distract her from the distraction now.
lines.zh: 她现在需要一个分心的事物，来让她从那个分心的事物里分心。

lines.en: And so she found one — hyperventilating in the bathroom and telling herself that everything was going to be okay.
lines.zh: 于是她找到了一个——在洗手间里过度换气，一遍遍告诉自己一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: It was the youngest she felt in years.
lines.zh: 那是她这么多年来感觉最年轻的一刻。
全剧终。
{i}Yumi 的好感度提升到了 [yumi_love]!{/i}
